Register the repo-wide md-lint CI job (from shipment 106-S / feature 126-F) as a REQUIRED status check via GitHub branch protection. The gate is repo-wide and blocking from its first run (0 violations repo-wide via the MD025 _title config + the ~21 structural remediations), so NO advisory cycle is needed — this supersedes the earlier advisory-first framing. Branch-protection required-status-check configuration is done in the GitHub repo settings OUTSIDE the repository tree (not a code/CI file change), so it needs an operator/admin action and cannot be a normal in-repo Ship task.
